basic_info.description: Located in an amazing Sea Cliff location, this semi-detached craftsman shines with natural light.  A huge living room with fireplace, built-ins exemplifies the charm of the home.  Adjoining to the living room is the dining room that leads through french doors to the amazing garden.  Benefiting from indoor / outdoor living, the floor plan is perfect for entertaining with the crown jewel of the home being the walkout south facing deck and garden.  Newly updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartzite countertops, and contiguous breakfast room complete the main level.  The bedroom floor provides 3 bright bedrooms, one with a south facing deck.  There is a huge bathroom with a large vanity, soaking tub, and stall shower. Overlooking the garden is an additional flexible room, making an ideal office, or extra walk-in closet. In addition, there is a closet in the hall which could be a potential additional bathroom.  The lowest level consists of a bathroom, laundry, space for a potential family room or gym, and garage. Hardwood floors, fireplace, EV charger hookup and proximity to San Francisco's best beaches are only some of the many reasons this house is so spectacular.
